title: No Heal Border
description: A mod that disables all healing once a player travels too far away from spawn.
body:
No Heal Border is a server-side Fabric mod that creates a soft world border by disabling all health regeneration outside a configurable area.

Players are still able to travel beyond the border, but any damage taken outside cannot be healed until they return. This discourages very distant base locations without restricting exploration.

The mod blocks all forms of healing outside the border:
natural regeneration from food
Regeneration effects
Instant Health potions
absorption hearts (golden apples, effects)

The border is square, invisible in-game, and works per dimension (Overworld, Nether, End).

![Border Sketch](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/985f55c5bc42a8792bc24412abaefe8b6a5062c6.png)

When a player enters or exits the world border, this is communicated to them through an on-screen title notification.


You can Configure the origin and size of the border for every dimension in the Config file.
"\config\softborder_healblock.json"
